tools.name: fill_newsletter_signup
tools.description: Opens the Absurd Design newsletter sign-up form (updates and new illustrations) and fills in the email address. It does not subscribe anyone: the person reviews the address, ticks the consent box and presses Subscribe, and a confirmation email follows. The form is shown only to visitors who are not signed in.

email.description: The email address to put in the form.

tools.name: get_membership_plans
tools.description: Returns the current membership plans with monthly and yearly prices, monthly download credits and included features, plus the pricing page URL. Membership is capped at 300 members at once. Read-only; joining happens on the pricing page.

tools.name: list_chapters
tools.description: Lists the chapters of the Absurd Design illustration library: surrealist, hand-drawn illustrations by one artist, Diana Valeanu (no AI-generated artwork). Returns each chapter's name, slug, page URL, whether it is free or for members, and its file types. Read-only.

tools.name: list_illustrations
tools.description: Lists the illustrations in one chapter, newest first: each one's title, page URL and preview image URL. Downloading happens on the illustration page. Read-only.

chapter.description: Chapter slug from list_chapters, for example "chapter9".

limit.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 50).

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Opens one of the site's public pages in this tab: home (Illustration library (home)), pricing (Pricing and membership), faq (FAQ), about (About the project), license (License overview), free_license (Free license), paid_license (Paid (member) license), what_is_illustration (What is illustration (guide)), privacy (Privacy policy), terms (Terms), sign_in (Sign in), sign_up (Sign up). For a chapter or illustration, use the URL returned by list_chapters or list_illustrations.
